summary.text: Ryan Clancy is a Democratic member of the Wisconsin State Assembly representing District 19, where he took office on January 3, 2023, and he is on the November 3, 2026 general election ballot seeking re-election against Republican Yasmine Outlaw.
A former Milwaukee Public Schools teacher and county supervisor, he is also a business owner and former Peace Corps volunteer.

paragraphs.text: Ryan Clancy was born in Glendale, Wisconsin, graduated from Nicolet High School in 1995, and earned a B.A. in English from Beloit College in 2000 and an M.A. in negotiation, conflict resolution, and peacebuilding from California State University, Dominguez Hills, in 2011.
His professional experience includes working as a teacher for Milwaukee Public Schools, as a counselor and counselor trainer at Legacy International, and as owner of Trounce Records.
He served in the U.S. Peace Corps and has volunteered as a legal observer for the American Civil Liberties Union and with the American Red Cross.
Clancy represented District 4 on the Milwaukee County Board of Supervisors from 2020 to 2024 and took his Assembly seat in January 2023.
For 2025-2026 his committee assignments were Corrections, Housing and Real Estate, Public Benefit Reform, and State and Federal Relations.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he listed progressive taxation, civil rights, LGBTQIA+ rights, reducing mass incarceration, housing as a human right and food justice among his policy priorities.
